insights.one_liner: FitForMe is a Rotterdam company of about 146 people making supplements for people after weight-loss surgery, active in 22 countries.

culture.text: About 146 people, headquartered in Rotterdam, making science-backed supplements and support for people after bariatric surgery or weight-loss treatment.
Many staff come from Erasmus University Rotterdam, Rotterdam University of Applied Sciences and University of Amsterdam, studying economics, business, marketing and dietetics.
Most people work in customer support, sales, business development and marketing.

open.text: Not listed as an IND recognised visa sponsor.
Its one open job here, an entry-level sales role in Rotterdam, does not require Dutch and mentions visas.
Present in 22 countries with online sales worldwide, so international markets are part of the job.

growth.text: Founded in 2005, privately held, now with about 146 employees.
